svg.title: TOPAK B8 — The policy floor in force, three gated stages from the genesis draft; and a fourth the reference links
svg.desc: floor/proposed/build.py builds the floor that the entries in force describe from floor/genesis-floor.cedar, in three cumulative stages, each validated, tested and gated: labels (ADR-0041 A1), control (A3) and emergency (A2). The last is the floor in force. It is genesis-provisional (ADR-0030 A3): gated, pinned and enforced, ratified by no batch, and ratified when the bootstrap reviewer establishes that it is fit, for which no test exists (G11 item 87). A fourth stage, workflow (ADR-0041 A4, pending), is drafted with ADR-0054, which is Proposed: it is not in force, and since 2026.10.08 it is the stage the reference links, at the custodian's direction (G11 §2.2, item 102).

svg.text: floor/proposed/build.py builds the floor that the entries in force describe from floor/genesis-floor.cedar, in three cumulative stages, each validated, tested and gated: labels (ADR-0041 A1), control (A3) and emergency (A2). The last is the floor in force. It is genesis-provisional (ADR-0030 A3): gated, pinned and enforced, ratified by no batch, and ratified when the bootstrap reviewer establishes that it is fit, for which no test exists (G11 item 87). A

fourth stage, workflow (ADR-0041 A4, pending), is drafted with ADR-0054, which is Proposed: it is not in force, and since 2026.10.08 it is the stage the reference links, at the custodian's direction (G11 §2.2, item 102).
carve-out, gap, what the gates do not show
build step: one stage is the previous plus one batch of records

text.tspan: The floor is genesis-provisional (ADR-0030 A3, Batch 34)
Genesis-provisional · ADR-0030 A3 · ratified at bootstrap

svg.text: Gated, pinned by digest and enforced, and ratified by no batch. It is ratified when the bootstrap reviewer establishes that it is fit, and says so in the review attestation the genesis bundle carries (ADR-0029 §5 step 6, A4). That gives floor fitness an owner and a time.

It does not give it a test (G10 item 2; item 87). The gates show a floor is consistent, total, non-vacuous and minimal; whether it is the right floor is the reviewer's judgment, and no record says how a reviewer tests that. No bootstrap reviewer is engaged and no review pass has run (G11 §4).

The floor in question is the one the entries in force describe (ADR-0030 A3): since Batch 34 that is emergency-floor.cedar and its schema. ADR-0041 ratified what the floor must contain, entry by entry, not a text. The control entries and the emergency change rest on records ratified

text.tspan: The stage files open with a comment that is wrong (G11 item 91)

svg.text: Every stage's floor and schema open: // PROPOSED · built by floor/proposed/build.py from the genesis floor · stage: emergency · not ratified, // and not what the
reference follows. The reference has linked a stage since c15026d: emergency from 9c57221, and workflow since 11aaf6a, of which the comment is now false.
The bytes are kept as gated, so the digests the gate results and the records cite are the digests the reference pins. Correcting the comment is a gate rerun and new digests in ADR-0047,
ADR-0050 and ADR-0052 (and the pins of ADR-0033 A10 to A12).

The values file is the same in every stage: genesis-values.json 85ab6fefb66f0316: K = 8, T_obs = 5000 ms, T_persona = 1 h, the five θ values unset. Every number is a placeholder. Each stage's gate run checks it first (ADR-0039 §1). Each step replaces a string asserted to occur exactly once in the genesis text, so a change to the genesis floor the build does not expect stops it instead of producing a wrong floor.

text.tspan: , drafted with ADR-0054, Proposed, and linked by the reference

svg.text: Records: + ADR-0054 (Proposed); ADR-0041 A4 (pending); ADR-0015 A1, ADR-0037 A5, ADR-0040 A2 (pending).
Adds the action Route, a permit R8 and a forbid R9; amends R3 to couple the orchestrator kind and cover Route.
30 policies · 123 cases. Every gate passes, 2026.10.08: totality 44 holds°, 17 actions non-vacuous and discriminating, every entry matters, 17 new-entry routing controls, 22 unsat
with a checked proof, none without one; evidence tree 4ffc4fade540ab64, not copied. A rerun reproduces it byte for byte.
Cited by ADR-0054 R4 and ADR-0033 A16. Linked by the reference since 11aaf6a, at the custodian's direction: pinned in topak-floor, its 123 cases replayed through the linked
engine; stated in Lean (Linked.lean; TopakFloor-results-2026.10.08.txt). Every Run request lifts decisionPoint, empty for every lease but an orchestrator's.
The floor the reference follows is therefore not the floor in force (G11 §2.2, item 102). The emergency stage's bytes are unchanged.
principal.domain == "run" ∧ context.lease.alphabet.contains("Route") ∧ resource.chosen ∧ context.decisionPoint.contains(resource.source): a chosen edge out
of the decision point the lease was granted for
Actuate Report Route · (principal.kind == "thinker" || principal.kind == "orchestrator") && !context.observerLive: the orchestrator is coupled as a Thinker is
a sixth kind, Run only (ADR-0037 A5)
Edge { source: WorkflowNode, chosen: Bool }, read from the promoted text; nothing a guard reads is here: whether an edge is enabled is not policy
one node for an orchestrator's round, empty for every other seat; a set, so that the gates' proofs need no scoped assumption
context RunCtx; a principal emission (ADR-0015 A1)

text.tspan: What each stage adds, removes and asks of the lift
How a stage is made and checked

svg.text: python3 build.py writes, per stage, <stage>.cedarschema, <stage>-floor.cedar and
<stage>-tests.json. Generated: edit build.py, not the files.
cedar validate against the stage's schema, then cedar run-tests on its cases.
run-gates.py <stage> drives the genesis runner ../run-gates.py unchanged: same gates, same
checked solver, same negative and checker controls; then adds routing controls for the new entries.
A rerun reproduces each results file byte for byte, evidence digest included. The evidence itself (every
query, proof and checker verdict) is left in a temporary directory and not copied.
emergency-tests.json is tracked because the reference's floor tests replay it; the other two stages' cases

text.tspan: Not in the floor, at any stage (header of the genesis text)

svg.text: Epoch fencing: the mechanism, ahead of the floor (ADR-0022 §2).
The round bound: a count, mechanism-checked (ADR-0022 §3).
The rules floor: bounds issuances, not admits (ADR-0030 §7).
Invoke hermeticity: an obligation on each allowlist entry.
ADR-0047's F4 to F6: checks on bundle data at load (ADR-0049 §6, W7 to W9), made by the mechanism. Not
A first lease: granted by the mechanism when a quorum completes (ADR-0050 §2); not an action, no entry.
clearSet holds untrusted, and restricted is in clearSet or in
clearSet holds untrusted, and a destination input is a literal
a destination input is a handle whose label holds untrusted
Each is a set-membership test on attributes the mechanism computed. untrusted and restricted are the two names
the floor reserves. As forbids they deny whatever permit is satisfied (ADR-0047 §7).

text.tspan: Schema S gains (ADR-0030 A2; ADR-0041 §4 A1)

svg.text: derived by the lift from the entry's channel and the
issued rules' list of targets inside the deployment;
labels of everything delivered clear to this principal this
join of the labels of the call's inputs that are handles
an input the entry marks a destination is a literal
join of the labels of destination inputs that are handles
Written by the lift, from the record and the entry of the granted bundle revision; no policy computes them. clearSet is the
first attribute in S that depends on the round's history, a monotone fold, and history enters S only so (ADR-0030 A2).
Report takes clearSet and no entry reads it yet.
Cases 62 → 74: twelve added, two of them R5 and R6 holding under X1. Routing controls: four (below).
an operator grants a seated target's next round, in its
own domain, same binding, an alphabet the last one's
an operator renews a live lease in its domain
a Build operator records that the gates ran
an operator whose Persona is in force ends a round,
revokes or fences, under a live lease or a fresh sign-on
no add without a live lease and a live peer
no regrant or renewal of oneself
no fleet fence without a live lease
no regrant whose task is unlabelled, or labelled outside
no ending of a round or revocation outside the
the operator's Persona is promoted and not revoked
the operator holds a live lease
another operator in the domain holds a live lease
a sign-on assertion naming the key and the current fence verified
the target was seated by a quorum and is not revoked
the target holds a live lease
Persona, bundle, confinement and seat are the last lease's
the round named is the last lease's, advanced by one
the last lease's alphabet · the alphabet asked for
the task's label · the labels the target's seating allows (ADR-0050 §5)
The operator supplies none of them. sameBinding and nextRound are compared by the lift, not in Cedar: a round
comparison is arithmetic on a Long, which the totality gate refuses because it can overflow; the alphabets are compared in
Cedar (ADR-0041 A3). Actions: Regrant, Renew, AttestGates, EndRound, Revoke (resource Seat or Artifact) and
Cases 74 → 106: thirty-two added. Routing controls: nine, the four of labels and five more.

text.tspan: : one permit removed, one forbid amended

svg.text: loses breakGlass: {quorum: Bool, tools: ToolSet}: an emergency seat's
envelope is its toolAllowlist, computed at activation; the roster's quorum granted
its lease and is not a request property (ADR-0052 §2)

text.tspan: How break-glass reads now (ADR-0041 §3 as A2 replaces it)

svg.text: No break-glass permit. The roster's quorum seats a named person on a seat of kind emergency for one round, on
a bundle revision whose allowlist is the envelope; its Actuate is admitted by R1 like any other.
R3 is unchanged and does not reach the seat: it names thinker seats (ADR-0039 A2). No exemption was written
R5 to R7 bind the person: they are forbids on Actuate whatever the seat's kind (A2, beside A1).
The seat holds Consult, Actuate and Report, and cannot vote, draft or submit, which is what ADR-0026 R7
The exceptions are one, erasure (ADR-0013 A1; ADR-0026 A2: R6's count is one).
Cases 106 → 107: the seven X1 and break-glass cases removed, eight added: an emergency seat calls a tool in its
envelope; is not coupled with no live Observer; is refused a tool outside it; reports with no live Observer; X1 retired, a
Thinker cannot reach the envelope; R6 binds the person; the seat cannot draft; cannot submit. Routing controls: eleven.

text.tspan: The gates, stage by stage (ADR-0030 §5 with A1): every gate passes in all four

svg.text: Values: K, T_obs read and placeholders named
Totality: never-errors, per policy per action it applies to
Non-vacuity and discrimination: always-allows and always-denies both refuted, per action
Every entry matters: the floor minus one policy is not equivalent
Routing: the four genesis candidates, classed by implies both ways
Routing, new entries: weakened is a relaxation, strengthened a tightening
Negative controls: each gate catches a defective floor
Checker controls: a solver that lies yields no holds (A1)
holds without a checked proof, whole run
unsat with a checked proof · sat · unknown (the three checker controls)

Checked, not proved (ADR-0046 §1). A holds✓ rests on the solver's proof, which the pinned ethos checker accepted against cvc5's rule signature (ADR-0030 A1); a holds° is one cedar decided without a solver query, by folding the authorizer term, and rests on the engine's faithfulness (T-0045-3). Every totality row in every stage is holds°; the emergency

and workflow stages' are also proved in Lean under cedar-spec's model (ADR-0053 R3, B36; H7). A refuted needs no proof: it can only subtract. Toolchain: cedar-policy-cli 4.13.0, cvc5 1.4.0, ethos 8dc85c4.

text.tspan: The seventeen new-entry routing controls, as the
Candidate F′ (from the stage that adds it)

svg.text: R5 reads only what was read in the clear
C7 removed: a lapsed operator may fence
B10 as at genesis: no emergency seat
B10 admits every kind for Actuate
R9 removed: any seat with Route may route
R3 couples Thinkers only, as before
The kind test moved into R8
Every one passes: the class computed is the class expected. A Byzantine author cannot relabel a relaxation as a tightening to take the cheaper path (ToO rev 15 §3.2).

The floor is consistent, total, non-vacuous and minimal (ADR-0030 A3): no policy errors on any action it covers, no action is always allowed or always denied, and removing any one policy changes the floor.
Each new entry is routed correctly: dropped or weakened, it is classed a relaxation; strengthened, a tightening. B10 is shown to admit the new kind for Actuate and nothing else (ADR-0041 A2).
Each stage passes the genesis gates as they stand, with no holds lacking a checked proof.
The cases: each stage validates against its schema and passes its cases; emergency's 107 replay through the engine the reference links (ADR-0033 A12).
That it is the right floor. Fitness is the bootstrap reviewer's judgment, with no test (items 2, 87).
The admit-time half only. F4 to F6 are load checks, W7 to W9, in Rust (ADR-0049 §6; ADR-0030 A2).

The floor trusts its inputs. clearSet, destLiteral, peerLive and the rest are facts the lift supplies; Labels.tla and Operators.tla model how they are computed. At the reference they are the deciding replica's, and apply re-checks only clearSet
That the stage the reference links is in force. workflow passes every gate and is Proposed; the reference follows it at the custodian's direction (G11 item 102).

An operator's request is decided twice over: the envelope is stated in Cedar and in Rust, and only the tests hold them together (ADR-0033 A11). The floor's decision on one is not modelled by trace validation (G10 §3).
spec/ is behind: RulesFloorBase.tla still carries bgScope and R6's bound of two (G10 item 90).

text.tspan: stage, the floor in force: 28, in file order (

svg.text: Evaluation: any satisfied forbid denies; else any satisfied permit allows; else deny, and the mechanism treats any evaluation error as a deny (ADR-0030 §1). build and run abbreviate principal.domain == "build" and == "run"; alphabet is context.lease.alphabet; operator abbreviates principal.kind == "operator". The retired X1 is shown where it stood, and is not counted.

text.tspan: Build envelopes: ADR-0022 §1 (six) · from the genesis draft

svg.text: build ∧ alphabet.contains("Invoke") ∧ resource in context.toolAllowlist ∧ context.inputsInWorkspace
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Emit") ∧ resource.owner == principal ∧ resource.epoch == context.epoch ∧ resource.round == context.round ∧ !resource.sealed

build ∧ alphabet.contains("Vote") ∧ context.voteRulesEpoch == context.rulesEpoch ∧ ((principal in context.grantRoster ∧ principal.kind == "grant") ∨ (principal in context.vetoRoster ∧ principal.kind == "observer"))

text.tspan: Carve-outs on the Build envelopes (four) · B10 amended at the

svg.text: principal.kind != "thinker" ∧ !(principal.kind == "emergency" && action == Actuate): an emergency seat, held by a person for one round, may Actuate and nothing else here

text.tspan: Run envelopes: ADR-0040 §1, stated as ADR-0041 §1 (three) · from the genesis draft

svg.text: principal.domain == "run" ∧ alphabet.contains("Actuate") ∧ resource in context.toolAllowlist. Also admits an emergency seat, over the envelope computed at activation
run ∧ alphabet.contains("Report") ∧ resource.owner == principal ∧ current epoch and round ∧ !resource.sealed

text.tspan: Run carve-outs: coupling (one) and the label minimum (three)

svg.text: principal.kind == "thinker" ∧ !context.observerLive. Names thinker seats, so it does not reach an emergency seat

text.tspan: Floor exceptions: ADR-0013 §2, count 1, bounded by ADR-0026 R6 (A2)

svg.text: Deleted. Was: run ∧ context.breakGlass.quorum ∧ resource in context.breakGlass.tools; the breakGlass fields left schema S with it. Not counted in the 28
context.erasureQuorum: FALSE from epoch 0, since genesis issues no erasure roster

text.tspan: seat's requests, ADR-0050 §4 (provisional), named by ADR-0041 A3 (nine)

svg.text: principal.kind == "operator" ∧ resource.domain == principal.domain ∧ context.targetSeated ∧ !context.targetLive ∧ context.sameBinding ∧ context.nextRound ∧ context.lastAlphabet.containsAll(context.newAlphabet)
operator ∧ context.personaInForce ∧ (context.hasLease ∨ context.freshAssertion): a deny needs no lease
!context.hasLease: the one deny that needs a live lease
resource.domain != principal.domain. Not in ADR-0050's first list of eight; confirmed by the custodian 2026.10.05

Counts: six Build envelopes, four Build carve-outs, three Run envelopes, four Run carve-outs, one exception, the forensic floor, four control permits and five control forbids: 28. The genesis draft's 17, plus three at labels, plus nine at control, less one at emergency. One policy set serves both domains, scoped by principal.domain and principal.kind, because the per-class floor question is open (ToO rev 15 §3.4). The workflow stage's three changes are in the band above.

Sources: G10 §1 (Batch 34), §1.2, §2.1, §2.3, §2.9, §3, §4, §7 items 2, 25, 90, 92, 93, §8; G11 §2.2, §3, §7 items 87, 91, 102; ToO rev 15 §2.10, §2.11, §3.1, §3.3, §7.10; ADR-0041 §1–§4, A1, A2, A3, A4, R2, R3; ADR-0054 §3, §12, R4 (Proposed); ADR-0033 A16 (pending); floor/proposed/workflow-floor.cedar, workflow.cedarschema, workflow-gates-results-2026.10.08.txt; floor/lean/TopakFloor/Linked.lean and floor/lean/TopakFloor-results-2026.10.08.txt; ADR-0030 §5, A1, A2, A3; ADR-0029 §5 step 6, A4; ADR-0047 §7, §8, R16; ADR-0050 §2, §4–§6, R8, R9;
